harnessSource.description: Where to install the harness core from. 'local' = the project root (file install, fast). 'github' = npx-from-repo path.

verbName.description: The verb the skill should author (becomes `harness <verbName>`).

variant.description: Which starter variant to author. 'wrap' wraps the fixture's `npm run demo`.

keepTempRepo.description: Leave the temp repo on disk for inspection instead of deleting it.
